title: France Faces a Double Squeeze: Rising Debt and Stubborn Inflation Cloud the… · 19 Aug
keywords: France, public debt, budget deficit, inflation, economic growth, fiscal policy, eurozone, EU fiscal rules, Banque de France, European Commission, austerity, cost of living, 2027 budget, euro area, bond markets
notes: France is confronting a deepening fiscal crisis as public debt surpasses 3.5 trillion euros and debt-servicing costs climb sharply, while households remain under pressure from inflation that has eased but not disappeared. The government is betting on gradual adjustment, but opposition voices and independent analysts warn the strategy may be too cautious for the scale of the problem. With the 2027 budget already emerging as a political battleground, the stakes extend well beyond France's borders, touching eurozone stability and EU fiscal credibility.
